name: pele-board
description: Lets your agent show plans, processes, architecture and progress as live diagrams in your browser.

interface.shortDescription: See your agent's plans and processes as live diagrams.
interface.longDescription: Your agent draws plans, processes, architecture and progress as Mermaid diagrams, checks them, and shows them on a live page in your browser that updates as the work moves on. Rendered by pele.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me a diagram of how this project is structured.
